Skip rendering of off-screen subtrees (auto + contain-intrinsic-size).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;code&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Use <code style="font-family:monospace;background:#eef2ff;color:#4338ca;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px;font-size:12px">display: grid</code> for layouts.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Use &lt;code&gt;display: grid&lt;/code&gt; for layouts.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>content-visibility</b> = <b>visible</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>code { content-visibility: visible; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches by tag name (p, a, h1…).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>element</code></li><li>B. <code>:focus-visible</code></li><li>C. <code>:last-of-type</code></li><li>D. <code>:placeholder-shown</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1937">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1938 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1939">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1939" data-page="1939" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1062"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1939 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1062 — bdi × flex-grow</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">bdi</span> <span class="badge prop">flex-grow</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">flex-grow</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;bdi&gt;</code> — isolates text so its direction does not affect surrounding text. How much an item grows to fill spare space (ratio).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;bdi&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Hello <bdi dir="auto" style="background:#fef9c3;padding:0 4px;border-radius:3px">مرحبا</bdi> world — isolated, layout-safe</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Hello &lt;bdi dir=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;مرحبا&lt;/bdi&gt; world&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>flex-grow</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>bdi { flex-grow: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches elements that HAVE the attribute.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>[attr]</code></li><li>B. <code>:last-child</code></li><li>C. <code>:is(sel, …)</code></li><li>D. <code>:lang(code)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1938">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1939 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1940">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1940" data-page="1940" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1063"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1940 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1063 — dd × grid-column</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">dd</span> <span class="badge prop">grid-column</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">grid-column</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;dd&gt;</code> — the description (details) for a term in a description list. Spans grid columns (shorthand: col-start / col-end).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;dd&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px;color:#4b5563;margin-left:18px">World Wide Web — the document-based part of the Internet. <i>(dd)</i></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;dl&gt;&lt;dt&gt;Web&lt;/dt&gt;&lt;dd&gt;World Wide Web — the document-based part of the Internet.&lt;/dd&gt;&lt;/dl&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>grid-column</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>dd { grid-column: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The value ends with the string.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:nth-of-type(n)</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>[attr$=…]</code></li><li>C. <code>:checked</code></li><li>D. <code>descendant (space)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1939">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1940 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1941">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1941" data-page="1941" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1064"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1941 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1064 — canvas × font-weight</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">canvas</span> <span class="badge prop">font-weight</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">font-weight</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;canvas&gt;</code> — a bitmap drawing surface controlled by the 2d api or webgl. The thickness of the text (100–900 or keywords).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;canvas&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><canvas width="200" height="80" style="border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:6px;background:#fff"></canvas><script>document.querySelector("canvas").getContext("2d").fillStyle="#4285f4",document.querySelector("canvas").getContext("2d").fillRect(10,10,80,40)</script></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;canvas id=&quot;c&quot; width=&quot;200&quot; height=&quot;80&quot;&gt;&lt;/canvas&gt; &lt;script&gt; const x = document.querySelector(&quot;#c&quot;).getContext(&quot;2d&quot;); x.fillStyle = &quot;#4285f4&quot;; x.fillRect(10, 10, 80, 40); x.fillStyle = &quot;#34a853&quot;; x.fillRect(100, 20, 80, 40); &lt;/script&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>font-weight</b> = <b>100–900</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>canvas { font-weight: 100–900; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The element is under the pointer.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:empty</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>:hover</code></li><li>C. <code>:valid / :invalid</code></li><li>D. <code>::before</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1940">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1941 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1942">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1942" data-page="1942" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1065"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1942 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1065 — map × text-align-last</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">map</span> <span class="badge prop">text-align-last</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">text-align-last</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;map&gt;</code> — defines a client-side image map: clickable regions on an image. Alignment of the last line (matters with justify).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;map&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="width:190px;height:90px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#bae6fd,#34d399);border-radius:8px;position:relative;font-size:10px"><span style="position:absolute;top:8px;left:10px;color:#0c4a6e;border:1px dashed #0c4a6e;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px">rect: Beach</span><span style="position:absolute;bottom:8px;right:14px;color:#064e3b;border:1px dashed #064e3b;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px">circle: Lake</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;img src=&quot;island.png&quot; usemap=&quot;#island&quot; alt=&quot;Island map&quot;&gt; &lt;map name=&quot;island&quot;&gt; &lt;area shape=&quot;rect&quot; coords=&quot;0,0,120,80&quot; href=&quot;/beach&quot; alt=&quot;Beach&quot;&gt; &lt;area shape=&quot;circle&quot; coords=&quot;150,60,30&quot; href=&quot;/lake&quot; alt=&quot;Lake&quot;&gt; &lt;/map&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>text-align-last</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>map { text-align-last: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The element is being pressed/clicked.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:where(sel, …)</code></li><li>B. <code>:target</code></li><li>C. <code>::first-line</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:active</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1941">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1942 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1943">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1943" data-page="1943" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1066"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1943 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1066 — optgroup × hyphens</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">optgroup</span> <span class="badge prop">hyphens</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">hyphens</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;optgroup&gt;</code> — a labeled group of &lt;option&gt; elements inside a &lt;select&gt;. Automatic hyphenation of long words.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;optgroup&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:6px;padding:4px;background:#fff"><div style="font-weight:600;font-size:11px;color:#6b7280;padding:2px 8px">Fruits</div><div style="padding:3px 8px 3px 18px">Apple</div><div style="padding:3px 8px 3px 18px">Banana</div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;select&gt; &lt;optgroup label=&quot;Fruits&quot;&gt; &lt;option&gt;Apple&lt;/option&gt; &lt;option&gt;Banana&lt;/option&gt; &lt;/optgroup&gt; &lt;/select&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>hyphens</b> = <b>manual</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>optgroup { hyphens: manual; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The sole child of its parent.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:enabled / :disabled</code></li><li>B. <code>&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>::marker</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:only-child</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1942">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1943 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1944">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1944" data-page="1944" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1067"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1944 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1067 — table × background-position</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">table</span> <span class="badge prop">background-position</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">background-position</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;table&gt;</code> — a two-dimensional table of data. Where the background image sits.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;table&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><table style="border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11px;width:210px"><caption style="caption-side:top;font-weight:600;padding:4px">Monthly sales</caption><thead><tr><th style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;background:#f3f4f6;padding:4px 8px;text-align:left">Month</th><th style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;background:#f3f4f6;padding:4px 8px;text-align:left">Sales</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td style="border:1px solid #e5e7eb;padding:4px 8px">Aug</td><td style="border:1px solid #e5e7eb;padding:4px 8px">$12,400</td></tr><tr><td style="border:1px solid #e5e7eb;padding:4px 8px">Sep</td><td style="border:1px solid #e5e7eb;padding:4px 8px">$14,100</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;table&gt; &lt;caption&gt;Monthly sales&lt;/caption&gt; &lt;thead&gt;&lt;tr&gt;&lt;th&gt;Month&lt;/th&gt;&lt;th&gt;Sales&lt;/th&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/thead&gt; &lt;tbody&gt; &lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;Aug&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;$12,400&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt; &lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;Sep&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;$14,100&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt; &lt;/tbody&gt; &lt;/table&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>background-position</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>table { background-position: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “First of its tag among siblings.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:placeholder-shown</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>:first-of-type</code></li><li>C. <code>~</code></li><li>D. <code>::cue</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1943">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1944 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1945">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1945" data-page="1945" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1068"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1945 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1068 — tr × backdrop-filter</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">tr</span> <span class="badge prop">backdrop-filter</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">backdrop-filter</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;tr&gt;</code> — a single row inside a table body/head/footer. Filters what is BEHIND the element (glassmorphism!).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;tr&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:11px;display:flex;border-top:1px solid #e5e7eb"><div style="padding:4px 10px;flex:1">Aug</div><div style="padding:4px 10px;flex:1">$12,400</div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;Aug&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;$12,400&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>backdrop-filter</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>tr { backdrop-filter: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Everything EXCEPT the selector inside.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:lang(code)</code></li><li>B. <code>::first-letter</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>:not(sel)</code></li><li>D. <code>.class</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1944">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1945 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1946">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1946" data-page="1946" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1069"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1946 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1069 — blink × counter-increment</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">blink</span> <span class="badge prop">counter-increment</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">counter-increment</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;blink&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: blink (obsolete). Increment a CSS counter.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;blink&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><span style="font-size:13px;color:#9ca3af">Blink no longer exists — and blinking text hurts accessibility.</span></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;blink&gt;Blinking&lt;/blink&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>counter-increment</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>blink { counter-increment: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Parent selector! Matches if it CONTAINS the selector.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:has(sel)</code></li><li>B. <code>descendant (space)</code></li><li>C. <code>::placeholder</code></li><li>D. <code>[attr=value]</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1945">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1946 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1947">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1947" data-page="1947" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1070"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1947 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1070 — applet × scroll-snap-align</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">applet</span> <span class="badge prop">scroll-snap-align</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">scroll-snap-align</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;applet&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: applet (obsolete). Where the child snaps inside the container (start/center/end).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;applet&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px;color:#9ca3af">Java applets: extinct. Games are now <canvas>/WebGL/JS.</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;applet code=&quot;Game.class&quot; width=200 height=100&gt;&lt;/applet&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>scroll-snap-align</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>applet { scroll-snap-align: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Field required or not.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>::before</code></li><li>B. <code>::file-selector-button</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>:required / :optional</code></li><li>D. <code>[attr*=…]</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1946">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1947 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1948">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1948" data-page="1948" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1071"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1948 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1071 — a × transition-delay</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">a</span> <span class="badge prop">transition-delay</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">transition-delay</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;a&gt;</code> — creates a hyperlink to a page, a section, a file, an email, or a phone number. Wait this long before the transition starts.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;a&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px;display:grid;gap:4px"><a href="#" style="color:#2563eb">W3Schools HTML <span style="font-size:10px">↗ (target=_blank)</span></a><a href="#" style="color:#2563eb">Jump to #contact</a><a href="#" style="color:#2563eb">Email us (mailto:)</a></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;a href=&quot;https://w3schools.com/html/&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; rel=&quot;noopener&quot;&gt;W3Schools HTML&lt;/a&gt; &lt;a href=&quot;#contact&quot;&gt;Jump to contact&lt;/a&gt; &lt;a href=&quot;mailto:hi@example.com&quot;&gt;Email us&lt;/a&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>transition-delay</b> = <b>time</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>a { transition-delay: time; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Number input within / outside min-max.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>::first-line</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>:in-range / :out-of-range</code></li><li>C. <code>element</code></li><li>D. <code>:focus</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1947">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1948 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1949">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1949" data-page="1949" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1072"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1949 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1072 — link × transform</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">link</span> <span class="badge prop">transform</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">transform</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;link&gt;</code> — links an external resource, most commonly a stylesheet. Move/rotate/scale/skew the element (GPU-friendly, doesn&#x27;t reflow).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;link&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center"><span style="width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:4px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4285f4,#34a853)"></span><code style="font-family:monospace;font-size:12px">style.css → linked</code></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;link rel=&quot;stylesheet&quot; href=&quot;style.css&quot;&gt; &lt;link rel=&quot;icon&quot; href=&quot;logo.svg&quot;&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>transform</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>link { transform: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Element&#x27;s text direction matches.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:dir(dir)</code></li><li>B. <code>::marker</code></li><li>C. <code>[attr]</code></li><li>D. <code>:first-child</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1948">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1949 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1950">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1950" data-page="1950" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1073"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1950 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1073 — div × height</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">div</span> <span class="badge prop">height</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">height</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;div&gt;</code> — a neutral block-level container with no semantic meaning. Sets the height of an element.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;div&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="border:1px solid #d0d7de;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;background:#fafbfc;width:220px"><b style="font-size:13px">&lt;div class="card"&gt;</b><br><span style="font-size:12px;color:#57606a">a layout box with no meaning</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;div class=&quot;card&quot;&gt; &lt;h2&gt;Card title&lt;/h2&gt; &lt;p&gt;Card text&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/div&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>height</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>div { height: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The NEXT sibling, immediately after.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>::cue</code></li><li>B. <code>[attr$=…]</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>+</code></li><li>D. <code>:nth-child(n)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1949">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1950 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1951">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1951" data-page="1951" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1074"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1951 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1074 — main × padding</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">main</span> <span class="badge prop">padding</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">padding</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;main&gt;</code> — the dominant, unique content of the document. Space inside the border (all four sides).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;main&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="border:2px solid #4285f4;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;background:#f8fbff;width:260px"><b style="color:#1a56db;font-size:12px">MAIN CONTENT</b><br><span style="font-size:12px">Everything the user came here for lives inside <b>&lt;main&gt;</b>.</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;main&gt; &lt;article&gt;...the post...&lt;/article&gt; &lt;/main&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>padding</b> = <b>12px</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>main { padding: 12px; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Generated content INSIDE the end of the element.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>.class</code></li><li>B. <code>:hover</code></li><li>C. <code>:last-of-type</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>::after</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1950">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1951 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1952">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1952" data-page="1952" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1075"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1952 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1075 — h4 × border-radius</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">h4</span> <span class="badge prop">border-radius</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">border-radius</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;h4&gt;</code> — a section heading of importance level 4 (h1 = highest). Rounds the corners (all four in one declaration).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;h4&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-weight:700;font-size:16.0px;line-height:1.25;margin:2px 0">Heading level 4</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;h4&gt;Heading level 4&lt;/h4&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>border-radius</b> = <b>50%</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>h4 { border-radius: 50%; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The user&#x27;s text selection.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>[attr=value]</code></li><li>B. <code>:active</code></li><li>C. <code>:is(sel, …)</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>::selection</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1951">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1952 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1953">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1953" data-page="1953" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1076"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1953 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1076 — pre × inset</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">pre</span> <span class="badge prop">inset</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">inset</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;pre&gt;</code> — preformatted text where whitespace and line breaks matter (code, diagrams). Shorthand for top/right/bottom/left (one declaration).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;pre&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><pre style="background:#0d1117;color:#e6edf3;font-size:11px;padding:10px;border-radius:6px;margin:0">function sum(a, b) { return a + b; }</pre></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code&gt;function sum(a, b) { return a + b; }&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>inset</b> = <b>0</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>pre { inset: 0; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The dim layer behind an open &lt;dialog&gt;.showModal().”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>[attr*=…]</code></li><li>B. <code>:only-child</code></li><li>C. <code>:checked</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>::backdrop</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1952">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1953 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1954">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1954" data-page="1954" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1077"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1954 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1077 — strong × flex-direction</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">strong</span> <span class="badge prop">flex-direction</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">flex-direction</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;strong&gt;</code> — marks text of strong importance, seriousness or urgency. The main axis direction of a flex container.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;strong&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px"><strong>Warning:</strong> This action cannot be undone.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Warning:&lt;/strong&gt; This action cannot be undone.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>flex-direction</b> = <b>row</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>strong { flex-direction: row; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of display?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>block</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>inline</code></li><li>C. <code>banana</code></li><li>D. <code>solid2</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1953">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1954 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1955">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1955" data-page="1955" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1078"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1955 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1078 — cite × column-gap</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">cite</span> <span class="badge prop">column-gap</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">column-gap</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;cite&gt;</code> — the title of a creative work (book, film, song, page). Space between columns (grid columns / flex columns).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;cite&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Read <cite><i>Learn HTML5</i></cite> by freeCodeCamp.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Read &lt;cite&gt;Learn HTML5&lt;/cite&gt; by freeCodeCamp.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>column-gap</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>cite { column-gap: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of height?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>100dvh</code></li><li>B. <code>never</code></li><li>C. <code>always</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>auto</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1954">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1955 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1956">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1956" data-page="1956" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1079"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1956 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1079 — samp × place-content</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">samp</span> <span class="badge prop">place-content</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">place-content</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;samp&gt;</code> — sample output from a program or computer. Shorthand: align-content + justify-content (align the tracks themselves).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;samp&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">If you see <samp style="font-family:monospace;background:#fef2f2;color:#b91c1c;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px;font-size:12px">404 Not Found</samp>, the page is missing.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;If you see &lt;samp&gt;404 Not Found&lt;/samp&gt;, the page is missing.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>place-content</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>samp { place-content: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of border-collapse?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>collapse</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>separate</code></li><li>C. <code>auto2</code></li><li>D. <code>never</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1955">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1956 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1957">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1957" data-page="1957" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1080"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1957 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1080 — rp × font-kerning</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">rp</span> <span class="badge prop">font-kerning</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">font-kerning</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;rp&gt;</code> — fallback parentheses for ruby annotations in browsers without ruby support. Enable/disable kerning between letter pairs.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;rp&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px;font-family:serif;color:#6b7280">木(mù) — what old browsers would see</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;ruby&gt;木&lt;rp&gt;(&lt;/rp&gt;&lt;rt&gt;mù&lt;/rt&gt;&lt;rp&gt;)&lt;/rp&gt;&lt;/ruby&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>font-kerning</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>rp { font-kerning: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of position?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>static</code></li><li>B. <code>auto2</code></li><li>C. <code>never</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>relative</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1956">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1957 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1958">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1958" data-page="1958" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1081"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1958 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1081 — dt × text-underline-offset</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">dt</span> <span class="badge prop">text-underline-offset</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">text-underline-offset</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;dt&gt;</code> — the term (name) in a description list. Distance between the underline and the text.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;dt&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px;font-weight:700">term <span style="font-weight:400;color:#6b7280">(dt)</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;dl&gt;&lt;dt&gt;term&lt;/dt&gt;&lt;dd&gt;definition&lt;/dd&gt;&lt;/dl&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>text-underline-offset</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>dt { text-underline-offset: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of overflow-wrap?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>normal</code></li><li>B. <code>banana2</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>break-word</code></li><li>D. <code>auto9</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1957">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1958 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1959">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1959" data-page="1959" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1082"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1959 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1082 — track × writing-mode</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">track</span> <span class="badge prop">writing-mode</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">writing-mode</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;track&gt;</code> — captions, subtitles or chapters for &lt;video&gt;/&lt;audio&gt;. The flow direction of the text (horizontal, vertical, and which way).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;track&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;background:#000;color:#fff;border-radius:6px;padding:10px;text-align:center">“Welcome to the course”</div><div style="text-align:center;font-size:10px;color:#6b7280">CC · English (default) · Chapters</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;video controls&gt; &lt;source src=&quot;movie.mp4&quot;&gt; &lt;track kind=&quot;captions&quot; src=&quot;en.vtt&quot; srclang=&quot;en&quot; label=&quot;English&quot; default&gt; &lt;/video&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>writing-mode</b> = <b>vertical-rl</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>track { writing-mode: vertical-rl; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of contain?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>none</code></li><li>B. <code>layout</code></li><li>C. <code>auto2</code></li><li>D. <code>never</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1958">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1959 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1960">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1960" data-page="1960" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1083"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1960 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1083 — param × opacity</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">param</span> <span class="badge prop">opacity</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">opacity</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;param&gt;</code> — a named parameter passed to an &lt;object&gt; resource. The overall transparency of the element (0–1).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;param&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;background:#f6f8fa;border:1px solid #d0d7de;border-radius:6px;padding:8px">name="quality" value="high" → passed to the object</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;object data=&quot;game.swf&quot; type=&quot;application/x-shockwave-flash&quot;&gt; &lt;param name=&quot;quality&quot; value=&quot;high&quot;&gt; &lt;/object&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>opacity</b> = <b>0.8</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>param { opacity: 0.8; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of backface-visibility?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>visible</code></li><li>B. <code>hidden</code></li><li>C. <code>banana2</code></li><li>D. <code>auto9</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1959">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1960 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1961">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1961" data-page="1961" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1084"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1961 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1084 — option × shape-outside</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">option</span> <span class="badge prop">shape-outside</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">shape-outside</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;option&gt;</code> — a single choice inside &lt;select&gt; id=&quot;a&quot; value=&quot;3&quot; aria-label=&quot;A&quot;&gt; × &lt;input type=&quot;number&quot; id=&quot;b&quot; value=&quot;4&quot; aria-label=&quot;B&quot;&gt; = &lt;output name=&quot;result&quot; for=&quot;a b&quot;&gt;12&lt;/output&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>resize</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>output { resize: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of flex?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>none</code></li><li>B. <code>1</code></li><li>C. <code>auto2</code></li><li>D. <code>never</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1961">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1962 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1963">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1963" data-page="1963" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1086"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1963 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1086 — tfoot × appearance</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">tfoot</span> <span class="badge prop">appearance</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">appearance</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;tfoot&gt;</code> — groups the footer (summary) rows of a table. Reset or request the native form-control look.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;tfoot&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:11px;border-top:2px solid #374151;display:flex"><div style="padding:4px 10px;font-weight:700">Total</div><div style="padding:4px 10px">$26,500</div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;table&gt; &lt;tfoot&gt;&lt;tr&gt;&lt;th&gt;Total&lt;/th&gt;&lt;td&gt;$26,500&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/tfoot&gt; &lt;tbody&gt;…&lt;/tbody&gt; &lt;/table&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>appearance</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>tfoot { appearance: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of font-size?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>rem</code></li><li>B. <code>px</code></li><li>C. <code>never</code></li><li>D. <code>always</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1962">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1963 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1964">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1964" data-page="1964" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1087"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1964 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1087 — big × animation-iteration-count</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">big</span> <span class="badge prop">animation-iteration-count</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">animation-iteration-count</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;big&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: big (obsolete). How many times it loops (infinite = forever).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;big&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><span style="font-size:15px">Bigger text — via CSS font-size</span></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;big&gt;Bigger text&lt;/big&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>animation-iteration-count</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>big { animation-iteration-count: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of font-optical-sizing?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>auto</code></li><li>B. <code>always</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>off</code></li><li>D. <code>banana2</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1963">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1964 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1965">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1965" data-page="1965" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1088"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1965 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1088 — noframes × perspective-origin</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">noframes</span> <span class="badge prop">perspective-origin</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">perspective-origin</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;noframes&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: no frames fallback (obsolete). Where the vanishing point sits (x y).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;noframes&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px;color:#9ca3af">Frames are gone — so is <noframes>.</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;noframes&gt;Your browser doesn&#x27;t support frames.&lt;/noframes&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>perspective-origin</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>noframes { perspective-origin: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of text-transform?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>none</code></li><li>B. <code>banana2</code></li><li>C. <code>auto9</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>capitalize</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1964">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1965 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1966">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1966" data-page="1966" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1089"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1966 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1089 — slot × margin</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">slot</span> <span class="badge prop">margin</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">margin</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;slot&gt;</code> — a placeholder in a shadow dom template where light-dom content is projected. Space outside the border (all four sides in one declaration).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;slot&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><span style="color:#0d9488;font-size:13px">Hello shadow <i>(projected into the slot)</i></span></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;template shadowrootmode=&quot;open&quot;&gt; &lt;style&gt;span { color: teal; }&lt;/style&gt; &lt;span&gt;&lt;slot&gt;&lt;/slot&gt;&lt;/span&gt; &lt;/template&gt; &lt;my-comp&gt;Hello shadow&lt;/my-comp&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>margin</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>slot { margin: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of vertical-align?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>baseline</code></li><li>B. <code>auto9</code></li><li>C. <code>banana</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>middle</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1965">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1966 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1967">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1967" data-page="1967" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1090"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1967 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1090 — base × padding-block</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">base</span> <span class="badge prop">padding-block</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">padding-block</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;base&gt;</code> — sets the base url for all relative urls on the page. Logical top+bottom padding.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;base&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;background:#f6f8fa;padding:10px;border:1px solid #d0d7de">base URL = https://docs.example.com/ → &lt;img src="a.png"&gt; loads docs.example.com/a.png</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;base href=&quot;https://docs.example.com/&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>padding-block</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>base { padding-block: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of hyphens?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>none</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>manual</code></li><li>C. <code>auto2</code></li><li>D. <code>never</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1966">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1967 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1968">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1968" data-page="1968" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1091"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1968 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1091 — body × float</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">body</span> <span class="badge prop">float</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">float</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;body&gt;</code> — contains all the visible content of the html document. Floats the element left/right; text wraps around it.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;body&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="border:2px solid #d0d7de;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;background:#fff"><h1 style="margin:0 0 6px;font-size:18px">Hello</h1><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Everything visible lives inside <b>&lt;body&gt;</b></p></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;body&gt; &lt;h1&gt;Hello&lt;/h1&gt; &lt;p&gt;World&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/body&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>float</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>body { float: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of writing-mode?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>vertical-rl</code></li><li>B. <code>solid2</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>horizontal-tb</code></li><li>D. <code>auto2</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1967">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1968 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1969">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1969" data-page="1969" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1092"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1969 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1092 — footer × visibility</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">footer</span> <span class="badge prop">visibility</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">visibility</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;footer&gt;</code> — footer content for a page or section: copyright, contact, related links. Show or hide an element while keeping its space.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;footer&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="background:#111827;color:#9ca3af;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;font-size:12px;text-align:center">© 2026 Mega Book Inc. — <i>footer</i></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;footer&gt; &lt;p&gt;© 2026 Mega Book Inc.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/footer&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>visibility</b> = <b>collapse</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>footer { visibility: collapse; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of background-attachment?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>fixed</code></li><li>B. <code>always</code></li><li>C. <code>banana2</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>scroll</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1968">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1969 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1970">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1970" data-page="1970" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1093"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1970 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1093 — h3 × align-self</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">h3</span> <span class="badge prop">align-self</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">align-self</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;h3&gt;</code> — a section heading of importance level 3 (h1 = highest). Overrides align-items for one item.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;h3&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-weight:700;font-size:18.5px;line-height:1.25;margin:2px 0">Heading level 3</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;h3&gt;Heading level 3&lt;/h3&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>align-self</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>h3 { align-self: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of content?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>string</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>none</code></li><li>C. <code>banana</code></li><li>D. <code>solid2</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1969">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1970 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1971">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1971" data-page="1971" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1094"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1971 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1094 — wbr × grid-row</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">wbr</span> <span class="badge prop">grid-row</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">grid-row</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;wbr&gt;</code> — an optional line-break position inside long words/urls. Spans grid rows (shorthand: row-start / row-end).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;wbr&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="width:110px;font-size:12px;word-break:break-word">https://example<wbr>.com/very/wbr/allows/line-breaks/here</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;a href=&quot;https://example.com/very/long/path&quot;&gt;https://example&lt;wbr&gt;.com/very/long/path&lt;/a&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>grid-row</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>wbr { grid-row: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of touch-action?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>none</code></li><li>B. <code>banana</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>auto</code></li><li>D. <code>solid2</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1970">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1971 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1972">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1972" data-page="1972" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1095"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1972 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1095 — b × font-size</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">b</span> <span class="badge prop">font-size</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">font-size</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;b&gt;</code> — highlights text for utilitarian reasons without extra importance. Horizontal alignment of inline content in a block.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;mark&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Search results for <mark style="background:#fef08a;padding:0 2px;border-radius:2px">html</mark> on this page</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Search results for &lt;mark&gt;html&lt;/mark&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>text-align</b> = <b>justify</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>mark { text-align: justify; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of appearance?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>auto</code></li><li>B. <code>always</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>none</code></li><li>D. <code>banana2</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1972">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1973 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1974">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1974" data-page="1974" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1097"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1974 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1097 — kbd × word-break</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">kbd</span> <span class="badge prop">word-break</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">word-break</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;kbd&gt;</code> — represents user input, usually from a keyboard (shortcut keys). Where long words may break.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;kbd&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Press <kbd style="font-family:monospace;border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-bottom-width:2px;border-radius:4px;padding:1px 6px;font-size:12px;background:#f9fafb">Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd style="font-family:monospace;border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-bottom-width:2px;border-radius:4px;padding:1px 6px;font-size:12px;background:#f9fafb">S</kbd> to save.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Press &lt;kbd&gt;Ctrl&lt;/kbd&gt; + &lt;kbd&gt;S&lt;/kbd&gt; to save.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>word-break</b> = <b>break-all</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>kbd { word-break: break-all; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of animation-play-state?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>running</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>paused</code></li><li>C. <code>auto9</code></li><li>D. <code>banana</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1973">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1974 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1975">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1975" data-page="1975" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1098"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1975 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1098 — rt × background-image</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">rt</span> <span class="badge prop">background-image</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">background-image</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;rt&gt;</code> — the annotation text inside &lt;ruby&gt;. One or more background images (URLs, gradients, both).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;rt&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px;font-family:serif"><ruby>木<rt style="font-size:9px">mù</rt></ruby></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;ruby&gt;木&lt;rt&gt;mù&lt;/rt&gt;&lt;/ruby&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>background-image</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>rt { background-image: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which global attribute: “Makes the element&#x27;s content editable in place. true / false / plaintext-only. The browser shows a plain text-editing UI.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>inert</code></li><li>B. <code>itemtype</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>contenteditable</code></li><li>D. <code>slot</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1974">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1975 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1976">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1976" data-page="1976" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1099"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1976 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1099 — dl × filter</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">dl</span> <span class="badge prop">filter</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">filter</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;dl&gt;</code> — a list of term–description pairs (glossaries, metadata). Real-time image effects on the element (blur, brightness, grayscale…).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;dl&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><dl style="font-size:13px;margin:0"><dt style="font-weight:700">HTML</dt><dd style="margin:0 0 6px 18px;color:#4b5563">The markup language of the web.</dd><dt style="font-weight:700">CSS</dt><dd style="margin:0 0 0 18px;color:#4b5563">The styling language of the web.</dd></dl></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;dl&gt; &lt;dt&gt;HTML&lt;/dt&gt; &lt;dd&gt;The markup language of the web.&lt;/dd&gt; &lt;dt&gt;CSS&lt;/dt&gt; &lt;dd&gt;The styling language of the web.&lt;/dd&gt; &lt;/dl&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>filter</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>dl { filter: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which global attribute: “Whether the element can be dragged (HTML5 Drag &amp; Drop API). true / false. Default true for images and links.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>itemid</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>draggable</code></li><li>C. <code>part</code></li><li>D. <code>tabindex</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1975">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1976 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1977">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1977" data-page="1977" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1100"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1977 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1100 — audio × counter-reset</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">audio</span> <span class="badge prop">counter-reset</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">counter-reset</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;audio&gt;</code> — embeds an audio player (music, podcasts, sound effects). Enable scroll snapping on a container (x, y, both).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;object&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;width:200px;padding:10px;background:#eff6ff;font-size:11px">model.glb not supported here → fallback shows: "Download the model".</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;object data=&quot;model.glb&quot; type=&quot;model/gltf-binary&quot; width=&quot;200&quot; height=&quot;150&quot;&gt; &lt;p&gt;Your browser cannot show 3D models. &lt;a href=&quot;model.glb&quot;&gt;Download&lt;/a&gt;.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/object&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>scroll-snap-type</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>object { scroll-snap-type: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which global attribute: “Microdata: the property name of an item (e.g. itemprop=&quot;name&quot;).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>part</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>itemprop</code></li><li>C. <code>tabindex</code></li><li>D. <code>disabled</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1977">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1978 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1979">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1979" data-page="1979" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1102"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1979 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1102 — select × transition-timing-function</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">select</span> <span class="badge prop">transition-timing-function</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">transition-timing-function</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;select&gt;</code> — a dropdown list of options (single or multiple choice). Logical top+bottom margin (flips with writing mode).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;marquee&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="overflow:hidden;background:#111827;border-radius:6px;height:28px"><span style="display:inline-block;color:#fbbf24;font-size:12px;padding-left:100%;animation:none">Scrolling text — do the same with CSS keyframes + translateX</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;marquee&gt;Scrolling text&lt;/marquee&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>margin-block</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>marquee { margin-block: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which global attribute: “Advisory tooltip text on hover. At most one per page; can hurt mobile/keyboard UX if abused.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>selected</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>autofocus</code></li><li>C. <code>class</code></li><li>D. <code>inert</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1982">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1983 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1984">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1984" data-page="1984" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1107"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1984 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1107 — menu × right</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">menu</span> <span class="badge prop">right</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">right</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;menu&gt;</code> — a list of commands or items (context menus); behaves like &lt;ul&gt;.
