}</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which global attribute: “A form control is selectable but cannot be edited; its value still submits.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>id</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>readonly</code></li><li>C. <code>dir</code></li><li>D. <code>itemid</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1983">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1984 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1985">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1985" data-page="1985" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1108"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1985 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1108 — title × backface-visibility</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">title</span> <span class="badge prop">backface-visibility</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">backface-visibility</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;title&gt;</code> — defines the document title, shown in the browser tab and search results. Hide the element when it&#x27;s rotated to show its back.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;title&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="background:#202124;color:#fff;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:8px 8px 0 0;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center"><span style="width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:#4285f4"></span><b style="font-size:13px">Learn HTML — 8000 Page Bible</b> <span style="margin-left:auto">✕</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;title&gt;Learn HTML — 8000 Page Bible&lt;/title&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>backface-visibility</b> = <b>hidden</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>title { backface-visibility: hidden; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which global attribute: “The current value of inputs/outputs: text, number, date, file…”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>class</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>value</code></li><li>C. <code>inert</code></li><li>D. <code>itemtype</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1984">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1985 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1986">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1986" data-page="1986" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1109"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1986 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1109 — template × row-gap</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">template</span> <span class="badge prop">row-gap</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">row-gap</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;template&gt;</code> — an inert container of markup that can be cloned by javascript. Space between rows (flex lines / grid rows).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;template&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;font-size:12px;background:#f6f8fa;border:2px dashed #8b949e;padding:10px;color:#57609a">&lt;template&gt; content is <b>inert</b> — rendered only when JS clones it into the DOM</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;template id=&quot;card&quot;&gt; &lt;div class=&quot;card&quot;&gt;&lt;h3&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/div&gt; &lt;/template&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>row-gap</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>template { row-gap: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which global attribute: “Any ARIA attribute (aria-label, aria-expanded, aria-hidden, aria-live…) adds accessibility semantics when native HTML is not enough.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>aria-…</code></li><li>B. <code>dir</code></li><li>C. <code>itemid</code></li><li>D. <code>part</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1985">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1986 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1987">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1987" data-page="1987" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1110"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1987 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1110 — header × place-items</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">header</span> <span class="badge prop">place-items</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">place-items</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;header&gt;</code> — introductory content or a set of navigational links for a section or page. Shorthand: align-items + justify-items (align every cell&#x27;s content).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;header&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="background:linear-gradient(90deg,#4285f4,#34a853);border-radius:8px;padding:12px;color:#fff"><b style="font-size:15px">My Blog</b><div style="font-size:11px;opacity:.85;margin-top:2px">header — intro content for the page</div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;header&gt; &lt;h1&gt;My Blog&lt;/h1&gt; &lt;nav&gt;...&lt;/nav&gt; &lt;/header&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>place-items</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>header { place-items: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Defines the document title, shown in the browser tab and search results.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>&lt;title&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;strong&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;input&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;section&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1986">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1987 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1988">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1988" data-page="1988" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1111"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1988 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1111 — h2 × font-feature-settings</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">h2</span> <span class="badge prop">font-feature-settings</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">font-feature-settings</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;h2&gt;</code> — a section heading of importance level 2 (h1 = highest). Turn OpenType features on/off (ligatures, tabular nums…).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;h2&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-weight:700;font-size:21.0px;line-height:1.25;margin:2px 0">Heading level 2</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;h2&gt;Heading level 2&lt;/h2&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>font-feature-settings</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>h2 { font-feature-settings: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Machine-readable metadata about the document (encoding, viewport, description, authors).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;u&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;option&gt;</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>&lt;meta&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;nav&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1987">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1988 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1989">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1989" data-page="1989" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1112"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1989 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1112 — br × text-decoration-thickness</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">br</span> <span class="badge prop">text-decoration-thickness</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">text-decoration-thickness</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;br&gt;</code> — a single line break (forced newline) in the text. Thickness of the decoration line.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;br&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;background:#fafbfc;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;padding:8px;border-radius:6px">12 Main St.<br>Cairo, Egypt<br>12611</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;address&gt;12 Main St.&lt;br&gt;Cairo, Egypt&lt;br&gt;12611&lt;/address&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>text-decoration-thickness</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>br { text-decoration-thickness: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Content rendered only when scripting is disabled or unsupported.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;mark&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;noscript&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;textarea&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;main&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1988">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1989 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1990">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1990" data-page="1990" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1113"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1990 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1113 — span × direction</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">span</span> <span class="badge prop">direction</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">direction</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;span&gt;</code> — a neutral inline container with no meaning. Base text direction of the element (ltr / rtl).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;span&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Total: <span style="color:#16a34a;font-weight:700">$49</span> <span style="color:#9ca3af;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11px">$60</span></p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Total: &lt;span class=&quot;price&quot;&gt;$49&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>direction</b> = <b>ltr</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>span { direction: ltr; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A neutral block-level container with no semantic meaning.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;abbr&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;legend&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;figcaption&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>&lt;div&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1989">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1990 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1991">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1991" data-page="1991" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1114"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1991 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1114 — small × background-clip</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">small</span> <span class="badge prop">background-clip</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">background-clip</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;small&gt;</code> — side comments and small print: fine print, copyrights, legal notes. How far the background is painted (border-box / padding-box / content-box / text).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;small&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Offer ends Friday. <small style="font-size:11px;color:#6b7280">T&amp;Cs apply.</small></p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Offer ends Friday. &lt;small&gt;T&amp;Cs apply.&lt;/small&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>background-clip</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>small { background-clip: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Content tangentially related to the main content (sidebar, box, pull quote).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>&lt;aside&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;time&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;caption&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;h3&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1990">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1991 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1992">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1992" data-page="1992" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1115"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1992 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1115 — time × clip-path</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">time</span> <span class="badge prop">clip-path</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">clip-path</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;time&gt;</code> — a machine-readable date, time, or duration (calendar integration). Clip the element to a shape or path (non-rectangular boxes!).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;time&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Published <time datetime="2026-09-16" style="color:#1a56db;font-weight:600">16 September 2026</time></p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;time datetime=&quot;2026-09-16&quot;&gt;16 September 2026&lt;/time&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>clip-path</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>time { clip-path: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Footer content for a page or section: copyright, contact, related links.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;code&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;thead&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;h6&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>&lt;footer&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1991">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1992 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1993">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1993" data-page="1993" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1116"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1993 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1116 — ruby × user-select</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">ruby</span> <span class="badge prop">user-select</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">user-select</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;ruby&gt;</code> — japanese/chinese pinyin-style pronunciation annotation. Whether the text can be selected by the user.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;ruby&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px;font-family:serif"><ruby>中<rt style="font-size:9px">zhōng</rt></ruby>国<rp>(</rp><rt style="font-size:9px">guó</rt><rp>)</rp></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;ruby&gt;中&lt;rt&gt;zhōng&lt;/rt&gt;&lt;/ruby&gt;&lt;ruby&gt;国&lt;rt&gt;guó&lt;/rt&gt;&lt;/ruby&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>user-select</b> = <b>all</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>ruby { user-select: all; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Self-contained media (image, diagram, code) with an optional caption.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;sup&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;figure&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;tr&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;br&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1992">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1993 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1994">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1994" data-page="1994" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1117"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1994 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1117 — li × field-sizing</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">li</span> <span class="badge prop">field-sizing</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">field-sizing</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;li&gt;</code> — a single item inside &lt;ul&gt;, &lt;ol&gt; or &lt;menu&gt;. Let an input/textarea size itself to its content (content-based width).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;li&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><ol style="font-size:13px;margin:0;padding-left:22px;line-height:1.7"><li>Start</li><li value="10">Jumps to 10</li><li>Then 11</li></ol></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;ol&gt; &lt;li&gt;Start&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li value=&quot;10&quot;&gt;Jumps to 10&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Then 11&lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ol&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>field-sizing</b> = <b>content</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>li { field-sizing: content; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A section heading of importance level 2 (h1 = highest).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;rp&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;font&gt;</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>&lt;h2&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;blockquote&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1993">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1994 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1995">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1995" data-page="1995" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1118"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1995 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1118 — video × animation-delay</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">video</span> <span class="badge prop">animation-delay</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">animation-delay</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;video&gt;</code> — embeds a video player with optional controls, autoplay, loop and captions. Delay before the first cycle starts.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;video&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="width:230px;height:120px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1e3a5f,#0f172a);border-radius:8px;position:relative"><span style="position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center"><span style="width:0;height:0;border-left:22px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);border-top:14px solid transparent;border-bottom:14px solid transparent"></span></span><span style="position:absolute;bottom:6px;left:8px;font-size:10px;color:#e5e7eb">▶ clip.mp4 — controls</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;video controls width=&quot;320&quot; poster=&quot;thumb.jpg&quot;&gt; &lt;source src=&quot;clip.webm&quot; type=&quot;video/webm&quot;&gt; &lt;source src=&quot;clip.mp4&quot; type=&quot;video/mp4&quot;&gt; &lt;track kind=&quot;captions&quot; src=&quot;en.vtt&quot; srclang=&quot;en&quot; label=&quot;EN&quot;&gt; &lt;/video&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>animation-delay</b> = <b>time</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>video { animation-delay: time; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A section heading of importance level 5 (h1 = highest).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;ul&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;h5&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;big&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;dialog&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1994">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1995 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1996">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1996" data-page="1996" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1119"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1996 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1119 — embed × scale</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">embed</span> <span class="badge prop">scale</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">scale</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;embed&gt;</code> — embeds an external application (legacy plugin interface). Independent scale (composes with transform).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;embed&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;width:220px;padding:10px;background:#f9fafb;font-size:11px;font-family:monospace">document.pdf<br><span style="color:#6b7280">application/pdf — 100% × 400</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;embed src=&quot;document.pdf&quot; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A thematic break between paragraphs (scene change, topic shift).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>&lt;hr&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;dl&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;tt&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;strong&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1995">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1996 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1997">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1997" data-page="1997" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1120"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1997 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1120 — button × aspect-ratio</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">button</span> <span class="badge prop">aspect-ratio</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">aspect-ratio</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;button&gt;</code> — a clickable button: submit, reset, or script-triggered action. Locks the width:height ratio (16/9, 1/1, 4/3…).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;button&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="display:flex;gap:8px"><button style="background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;padding:7px 16px;font-size:12px">Search (submit)</button><button style="background:#f3f4f6;color:#374151;border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;padding:7px 14px;font-size:12px">Clear (button)</button></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;form&gt; &lt;input name=&quot;q&quot; required&gt; &lt;button type=&quot;submit&quot;&gt;Search&lt;/button&gt; &lt;button type=&quot;button&quot; id=&quot;clear&quot;&gt;Clear&lt;/button&gt; &lt;/form&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>aspect-ratio</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>button { aspect-ratio: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Preformatted text where whitespace and line breaks matter (code, diagrams).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>&lt;pre&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;img&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;frameset&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;u&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1996">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1997 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1998">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1998" data-page="1998" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1121"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1998 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1121 — fieldset × padding-inline</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">fieldset</span> <span class="badge prop">padding-inline</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">padding-inline</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;fieldset&gt;</code> — groups related form controls with a border and a &lt;legend&gt; caption. Logical left+right padding (flips with direction).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;fieldset&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px 10px 4px;font-size:12px;max-width:250px"><span style="position:relative;top:-13px;left:8px;background:#fff;padding:0 6px;font-weight:600">Delivery</span><div style="display:grid;gap:5px;margin-top:4px"><label style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center"><input type="radio" name="d" checked> Standard (3 days)</label><label style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center"><input type="radio" name="d"> Express (1 day, +$5)</label></div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;fieldset&gt; &lt;legend&gt;Delivery&lt;/legend&gt; &lt;label&gt;&lt;input type=&quot;radio&quot; name=&quot;d&quot; checked&gt; Standard (3 days)&lt;/label&gt; &lt;label&gt;&lt;input type=&quot;radio&quot; name=&quot;d&quot;&gt; Express (1 day, +$5)&lt;/label&gt; &lt;/fieldset&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>padding-inline</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>fieldset { padding-inline: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “The visible caption of a &lt;details&gt; disclosure.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;video&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;basefont&gt;</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>&lt;summary&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;mark&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1997">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1998 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1999">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1999" data-page="1999" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1122"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 1999 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1122 — thead × box-shadow</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">thead</span> <span class="badge prop">box-shadow</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">box-shadow</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;thead&gt;</code> — groups the header rows of a table. One or more shadows around the box.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;thead&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:11px;display:flex"><div style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;background:#f3f4f6;font-weight:700;padding:4px 10px">Name</div><div style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;background:#f3f4f6;font-weight:700;padding:4px 10px">Role</div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;table&gt; &lt;thead&gt;&lt;tr&gt;&lt;th&gt;Name&lt;/th&gt;&lt;th&gt;Role&lt;/th&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/thead&gt; &lt;tbody&gt;…&lt;/tbody&gt; &lt;/table&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>box-shadow</b> = <b>multiple</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>thead { box-shadow: multiple; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Highlights text for utilitarian reasons without extra importance.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;canvas&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;dir&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;abbr&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>&lt;b&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1998">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1999 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p2000">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p2000" data-page="2000" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 1123"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 6</span><span>Page 2000 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 1123 — center × overflow-wrap</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">center</span> <span class="badge prop">overflow-wrap</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">overflow-wrap</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;center&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: center (obsolete). Break long words so they don&#x27;t overflow (break-word).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;center&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="text-align:center;font-size:13px;background:#f3f4f6;padding:6px">Centered via CSS, not &lt;center&gt;</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;center&gt;Centered text&lt;/center&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>overflow-wrap</b> = <b>normal</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>center { overflow-wrap: normal; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Marks stress emphasis — change in meaning if removed.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;iframe&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;a&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;time&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>&lt;em&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1999">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 2000 / 8000 · Practice 6</span> <a data-nav="next" href="../volumes/vol-05.html#p2001">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <script> (function(){ var pageEl = document.querySelector('.page[data-page]'); if(!pageEl) return; // hash scroll function goHash(){ if(location.hash){ var t = document.querySelector(location.hash); if(t) t.scrollIntoView(); } } window.addEventListener('load', goHash); window.addEventListener('hashchange', goHash); // keyboard document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.target.matches('input,textarea')) return; if(e.key === 'ArrowRight'){ var n = document.querySelector('a[data-nav="next"]'); if(n) n.click(); } if(e.key === 'ArrowLeft'){ var p = document.querySelector('a[data-nav="prev"]'); if(p) p.click(); } }); // jump (every page has one) var boxes = document.querySelectorAll('.jump-input'); for(var bi = 0; bi < boxes.length; bi++){ (function(box){ box.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.key !== 'Enter') return; var n = parseInt(box.value, 10); if(!n || n < 1 || n > 8000){ box.value=''; box.placeholder='1–8000'; return; } var vol = Math.ceil(n / 500); location.href = 'vol-' + String(vol).padStart(2, '0') + '.html' + '#p' + n; }); })(boxes[bi]); } })(); </script> </body> </html>
